June 11

50 But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole. (Luke 8:50 KJV)

This is where a man named Jairus came and asked Jesus to heal his daughter who was sick (Luke 8:41-42). On the way to his house, servants came and told them that his daughter had died. Why did Jesus tell Jairus to “believe only”? It is because Jairus needed to have faith for his daughter to be raised from death, and not fear and unbelief. Fear is the opposite of faith, and if you have fear in your heart, the unbelief that it causes will keep faith from working. Jesus, even though He was God in the flesh, still could not overcome large amounts of unbelief when present, like in His hometown (Mark 6:4-5).

Most people don’t realize that we can limit God. God’s power is awesome, but to be used here on earth, it must flow through human beings (Ephesians 3:20), as we have dominion on earth (Genesis 1:26). The belief that God can, or will, do anything He wants to do here on earth is not right, as He has limited Himself to working through humans. God is all-powerful, but He will not use that power if He has limited it by His Words. God has put His Word even above His name (Psalms 138:2), so everything in the universe is held together by His Word (Colossians 1:17), and He can not lie (Titus 1:2), so when He has put limits on what He will do, then He will abide by what He has said, without fail. Praise God for His integrity.
